channel.title: Wiz incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Wiz's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: We are investigating an issue affecting some Wiz services for tenants hosted in the AWS us-west-2 region, related to an ongoing AWS service disruption [resolved]
Portal and API Service Degradation Across Multiple US Data Centers [resolved]
Elevated error rates due to an upstream dependency [resolved]

We are currently investigating an issue affecting Tenable Cloud integrations, where asset fetching may not complete for some customers, and are working with the relevant teams to restore normal operation. [resolved]
We are currently seeing delays and possible data loss in sensor ATM ingestion, including RED ingestion and VIR. [resolved]
Intermittent login failures [resolved]
Starting at 08:30 UTC, a subset of audit events may not have been recorded as expected. [resolved]
Wiz Sensor and Wiz Defend on prod-us54 may be experiencing delayed data ingestion of approximately one hour. Our team is investigating and working to restore normal processing. [resolved]
Degraded performance of Security Graph in DC US48 [resolved]

AWS infrastructure issues in us-east-1 are currently impacting our backend processing and portal search functionality. Users may see delays in data updates and search results while AWS works on a resolution [resolved]
Intermittent login failures affecting prod-eu24 only [resolved]
The GitHub streaming integration has stopped sending events. [resolved]
Intermittent Performance Issues Affecting EU4 [resolved]
Some customers may see critical issues created from incorrectly classified vulnerability findings for CVE-2026-4800, CVE-2026-33937, CVE-2026-33938, and CVE-2026-33940 [resolved]

We are investigating an issue causing false positive issues on controls wc-id-3088, wc-id-3089, wc-id-3090, wc-id-3091, and wc-id-3092 related to leaked cloud keys. These issues can be ignored and do not require investigation at this time. [resolved]
We are investigating intermittent login issues affecting some single sign-on flows, where a subset of users may experience repeated redirects or delays when signing in. [resolved]
We are experiencing delays in IAM event processing in prod-us54, which may cause delays in newly created or updated events for customers in this data center. [resolved]
Users in US72 may experience delays in updates and deletions for vulnerability findings in the graph. [resolved]
AWS me-central-1 Service Disruption [investigating]
item.description: We are monitoring the ongoing AWS service disruption in the me-central-1 region. Recovery of affected Wiz services is dependent on AWS resource availability in the region, followed by validation and restoration activities on our side. AWS status: https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status Affected Wiz DC: prod-me1

item.title: We are currently investigating an issue affecting email delivery from our production environment. Due to a temporary restriction on our email service provider account, some verification emails may not be delivered. [resolved]
AWS service disruptions affecting the me-central-1 region, affected DCs: prod-me1 [resolved]
We are investigating increased processing latency affecting Serverless scan results in several data centers - prod-us38, prod-us24, prod-us43, prod-us8, and prod-eu16. [resolved]
AWS service disruptions affecting the me-central-1 region, affected DCs: prod-me1 [resolved]
item.description:
The issue will be fully resolved once AWS restores the affected services in the region. We are actively monitoring the situation and closely tracking AWS status updates.
In parallel, our team continues working internally with impacted users to minimize disruption and restore functionality within our platform wherever possible.
We will provide further updates as soon as AWS confirms full service restoration.
AWS status: https://health.aws.amazon.com/health/status?path=service-history

item.title: AWS service disruptions affecting the me-central-1 region, effected DC's: prod-me1 [resolved]
Intermittent login failures affecting prod-us54 only [resolved]

Terraform Run Task scans may fail for some customers due to a recent update. Code/TF scan results might not be produced during this time. We are actively working on a hotfix to restore normal service. [resolved]
Investigating a gap in cloud storage log events (AWS S3, Azure Storage, GCP Cloud Storage) from Feb 4–Feb 9 [resolved]
item.description: ingestion is restored and we are evaluating options to recover missing data.
